programme.desc: Jim Morrison, the iconic frontman of the Doors, inspired a generation; Jim's life story reveals a rock star chameleon, constantly seeking out his own true identity, a journey that would end tragically with his death at the age of just 27.

programme.title: Fort Yuma Gold
programme.desc: Toward the end of the Civil War, a Confederate major plans the daring robbery of his own fort's gold bullion.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: This mostly fictional account follows the trigger-happy Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa (Telly Savalas) in his attempt to kill bitter nemesis Gen. Goyo and overthrow Mexico's government. The violent endeavor brings Villa north to New Mexico, where he battles a group of determined American soldiers led by the no-nonsense Col. Wilcox (Chuck Connors), and endures unanticipated mishaps and bad fortune, including a double-cross by his friend and partner, Scotty (Clint Walker).

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: The Sweetest Thing
programme.desc: When it comes to dating, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) has a golden rule: avoid searching for Mr. Right and focus on Mr. Right Now. That is until one night at a club when she unexpectedly meets Peter (Thomas Jane), only to see him suddenly disappear the next day. She and her best friend Courtney (Christina Applegate) decide to break the rules and go on a road trip to find him, encountering wild and hilarious misadventures along the way.

programme.title: A Slipping-Down Life
programme.desc: "Drumstrings" Casey (Guy Pearce) is an aspiring rock musician, though he hasn't had much success so far. Evie Decker (Lili Taylor) is likewise searching for direction and meaning. She works at an amusement park by day and at night bides her time alongside her troubled father. Between the two, Evie might be the more emotionally disturbed, as evidenced by how obsessed she becomes with Casey -- going so far as to carve his name across her forehead. They get married, but can their love last?

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: Vince Hopgood is a recently divorced theater owner with some serious tax problems. When Vince learns that a new tax loophole for live-in gay couples would allow him to keep his property, he asks his best friend, Ralph, to pose as his lover. In order to fool the taxman, the gruff, small-town Aussie pals make a clueless attempt to act like a homosexual couple. Along the way, they befriend actual gays and reevaluate stereotypes of the gay community.

programme.desc: The cast and crew plus a few celebrity guests share their memories of Britain's most-loved comedy.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: The Hurricane
programme.desc: Denzel Washington is Rubin "Hurricane" Carter, a man whose dreams of winning the middleweight boxing title were destroyed when he was arrested along with another man for the murders of 3 people in a New Jersey bar. Wrongfully accused, Carter and John Artis were sentenced to 3 life terms in prison.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: A former government operative comes out of retirement and uses all his extensive training to rescue his estranged daughter from a slave trade operation.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: The Boys Are Back
programme.desc: After the untimely passing of his second wife, Joe (Clive Owen) must deal with his grief as he strives to find a way to raise his sons alone. The boys, Artie and Harry, are trying to cope with their own emotional baggage, so the three decide to throw convention to the wind and live by the words "just say yes." When things go wrong, Joe must find a way to behave more like a parent while maintaining the joys of a more-carefree life.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.desc: A big screen spin-off of the "Saturday Night Live" skit. Rob Lowe plays a producer that wants to take the public access "Wayne's World" to the world of commercial television. Wayne (Mike Myers) and Garth (Dana Carvey) battle to save their show and Wayne's girlfriend from Lowe.

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: Quiet adolescent Sam (Rory Culkin) has been bullied by George (Josh Peck), a fellow student who has trouble fitting in with other teens. When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives.

programme.desc: Tarzán es una serie que se emitió en NBC desde 1966 hasta 1968. La serie retrataba a Tarzán como un personaje bien educado, uno que, cansado de la civilización, había regresado a la jungla donde había crecido. El programa mantuvo muchos de los elementos de la serie clásica de películas, incluyendo Cheeta, aunque excluyó otros elementos, como Jane, como parte del 'nuevo aspecto' para el legendario simio que el productor Sy Weintraub había introducido en películas anteriores protagonizadas por Gordon Scott, Jock Mahoney y Mike Henry. CBS emitió episodios repetidos del programa durante el verano de 1969. ★ 6.9/10

programme.title: Royal Pains
programme.desc:
Royal Pains: es serie de televisión estadounidense de la cadena USA Network, la cual fue creada por Andrew Lenchewski y John P. Rogers. Protagonizada por Mark Feuerstein, se estrenó el 04 de junio de 2009.
En la serie Hank (Mark Feuerstein) es un médico cirujano de urgencias en Nueva York que se ve obligado a dejar la ciudad, después de haber sido injustamente acusado de la muerte de un paciente, para trabajar como médico a domicilio en un lugar muy exclusivo, ubicado en las afueras de la ciudad. La vida de Hank, un triunfador nato, se desbarató tras la negligencia médica. Pero siguiendo los consejos de su hermano Evan termina en Los Hampton, paraje escogido por los millonarios para pasar sus vacaciones de verano, un sitio que a Hank, al principio, le resulta totalmente ajeno.
Todo inicia cuando Evan le lleva a pasar un fin de semana a la exclusiva zona de los Hamptons y una casualidad provoca que Hank salve la vida a un hombre, con lo cual pronto toda la rica comunidad reclamará sus servicios como médico personal.
Hank en su nueva vida tendrá como acompañantes a su hermano, quien ve tener una oportunidad de oro para entrar en la vida de mujeres y dinero con la que siempre ha soñado; Divya Katdare, una joven de la alta sociedad cansada de su estilo de vida se apuntará como asistente de Hank; y Jill Casey, la administradora del hospital local de los Hamptons, quien pondrá a Hank en el compromiso de atender también a los menos favorecidos de la comunidad... ★ 6.7/10

programme.title: 123 Shabum
programme.desc: Shabum es un niño muy curioso y con mucha imaginación que pasa los días junto a su abuelo en su tienda mágica. Este es un lugar en donde se despliegan la imaginación, la alegría, las ilusiones y mucha magia. Usando su poderosa mente, Shabum convierte todo lo que imagina en realidad. Sus súper poderes no sólo le sirven para divertirse, por medio de ellos educa a los niños de manera entretenida. Sus aventuras muestran la importancia de la lectura y ayudan a los niños a desarrollar el vocabulario y fortalecer su creatividad. Magia, invención y el poder de la imaginación son los ingredientes perfectos para hacer de Shabum un gran amigo.

programme.title: Locos por los autos
programme.desc: Cuando Rick Harrison y el resto de la pandilla "Pawn Stars" necesitan restaurar el vehículo que están comprando, recurren a Danny Koker "The Count" ("El Conde"), quién dirige Count's Kustoms, una tienda de autos de Las Vegas. El Conde ahora tiene su propio programa de media hora donde muestra su capacidad de restaurar y personalizar autos clásicos. Cuando ve un vehículo que quiere, ya sea en una subasta de automóviles o en un restaurante de carretera, Koker hace todo lo posible por adquirirlo. Cuando tiene éxito, él y su equipo trabajan para restaurar y modificar los autos y motocicletas con el fin de recuperar rápidamente la inversión. Desde autos clásicos como Thunderbirds y Corvettes, hasta motocicletas y demás, si tiene ruedas, el equipo de Count's Kustoms puede hacer que se vean simplemente espectacular.

programme.title: My Last Love
programme.desc: Second to Last Love: Una mujer profesionista y soltera en sus 40 se pregunta si no debería haber más en su vida aparte del trabajo y la planificación de su retiro. Kang Min Joo (Kim Hee Ae) es una productora de televisión exitosa que se ha concentrado solo en su carrera y no ha tenido ningún interés en enredos románticos. Sin embargo, al ocurrir una serie de contratiempos, se pregunta si no debería haber algo más en su vida y si no debería vivir de manera diferente. Cuando Min Joo comienza a toparse constantemente con Go Sang Shik (Ji Jin Hee), quien trabaja como jefe de sección para el Medio Ambiente en el Ayuntamiento, los dos comienzan a discutir de inmediato y no se soportan. Las cosas se complican cuando Min Joo se muda a un nuevo apartamento en la pintoresca campiña, solo para descubrir que es propiedad de Sang Shik, quien también vive allí con su inmadura hermana, Go Mi Rae (Kim Seul Gi), hija de Ye Ji ( Lee Soo Min) y Park Joon Woo (Kwak Shi Yang), un amigo cercano de la familia y propietario de una cafetería. Joon Woo se enamora perdidamente de Min Joo y trata de sacarla de su zona de confort, mientras que Sang Shik está incómodamente irritado porque otro hombre está tras Min Joo. ¿Min Joo descubrirá que hay más en la vida después de la aparición de estos dos hombres en su vida? ★ 7.5/10

programme.title: Esta semana
programme.desc: My Wife’s Having an Affair this Week: ¿A quién recurres cuando tu vida feliz se hace añicos? Do Hyun Woo (Lee Sun Gyun) es un productor de televisión que se considera bendecido por su carrera exitosa y un matrimonio feliz. Pero su feliz existencia se ve estremecida cuando ve por accidente un mensaje de texto enviado a su esposa, Jung Soo Yeon (Song Ji Hyo), de parte de un hombre misterioso llamado Michael quien le dice que ha reservado una habitación de hotel dentro de un par de días y que no puede esperar a verla. Convencido de que su esposa está teniendo una aventura, Hyun Woo no sabe a quién recurrir por ayuda para salvar su matrimonio, por lo que termina entrando en un foro en línea para pedir consejo anónimo por parte de extraños. Las personas más cercanas a Hyun Woo no le resultan de ninguna ayuda. Su colega Ahn Joon Young (Lee Sang Yeob) está casado, pero a la vez obsesionado con su compañera de trabajo Kwon Bo Young (BoA), quien está divorciada. Su amigo abogado, es un gran mujeriego que hace lo imposible para ocultarle sus infidelidades a su desconfiada esposa, Eun Ah Ra (Ye Ji Won). ¿Podrá Hyun Woo sobrevivir a la peor crisis de su vida? ★ 6.7/10

programme.title: The Red King
programme.desc: S01 E02 An identification is made of the body and Grace is keen to prove it was murder, but a murder investigation team arrive from the mainland and take over proceedings.

programme.title: The Red King
programme.desc: S01 E03 A huge storm hits the island, forcing Grace to spend time with all the locals under the same roof; Grace continues to investigate Cai's death; Silas provides an interesting lead, The True Way.

programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.desc: Touring the Freedom Tower in Miami.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Two (1960-1970) Texas Western's historic win over Adolph Rupp's Kentucky team in the 1966 NCAA final marks a turning point in the SEC. Vanderbilt's Perry Wallace becomes the conference's first Black player, while at LSU, Pete Maravich rewrites the record books.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Three (1971-1979) Dale Brown brings an infectious personality to LSU while Pat Summitt begins her legendary coaching career at Tennessee. And the year after Adolph Rupp's death in 1977, his successor Joe B. Hall leads Kentucky to its first NCAA title in 20 years.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Four (1980-1989) Georgia's Dominique Wilkins and Auburn's Charles Barkley headline the SEC's successes in the early 1980s, while LSU's Dale Brown takes two teams to the Final Four. Pat Summitt wins her first two national titles at Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Five (1990-1998) Arkansas joins the SEC and becomes one of the conference's top teams, led by fiery coach Nolan Richardson and his "40 Minutes of Hell" attack. Kentucky returns to prominence, and at Tennessee, Pat Summitt wins three straight NCAA titles.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Six (1998-2010) In his first year at Kentucky, Tubby Smith becomes the third Black coach ever to win a national title. Florida's back-to-back NCAA crowns mark the rise of a new power. The Lady Vols win 2 straight NCAA titles as LSU reaches 5 straight Final Fours.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Seven (2011-2022) John Calipari continues the winning tradition at Kentucky with a national championship in 2012. Four years later, Pat Summitt passes away after battling early-onset Alzheimer's disease. Dawn Staley leads South Carolina to a pair of NCAA titles.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: S08 E50 — Vonni & Andrew Vonni's fallen for online sweet-talker Andrew and has sent him hundreds of dollars to prove his love; now, Nev and Kamie help Vonni discover if Andrew is his one true love.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: S08 E66 — Reese & Jesica Reese was always successful with women until he met Jessica, a gorgeous girl who was doing more than playing hard to get; when a shady set of phone numbers sparks Reese's suspicions, he calls on Nev and Kamie to investigate.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.desc: S04 E10 — 5-Ingredient Recipes These five-ingredient recipes are anything but boring; with a few pantry staples, these simple weeknight meals will be on the table in no time.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E01 — Game Day Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. Game days aren't for dinner parties, but they are a day for some fan-favorite finger foods, especially those you can make in advance. Frankie makes three no-fuss appetizers.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Winter Is Here The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E03 — Valentine's Day Frankie prepares a Valentine's Day dinner for under $15 with a bistro-style theme to up the romance. Why go to a crowded restaurant for an overpriced prix-fixe menu with bad service when you can prepare a simple yet decadent romantic meal at home?

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E04 — Beans Beans Beans Dried beans are affordable and healthy to prepare. Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making tasty recipes. We also take a field trip to the grocery store to shop the bulk aisle. They're also good for your heart.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E05 — Rent Week It's that time, the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge looks pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and also teaches us how to better prepare for this.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E06 — Mushroom Mania Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They're packed with nutritional value, and they're an affordable plant-based meat replacement. We'll learn about all things mushrooms and how to make some inventive, flavorful dishes.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E07 — No Kitchen No Problem Just because you're dorm living, road tripping, motel living, or haven't gotten that bachelor pad in shape yet, doesn't mean you can't make tasty meals from some handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E08 — Spring Fling Spring is in the air which means a whole new world opens up in the produce department, especially all the greens. Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It's tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E09 — Spice Is Nice Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. You know that area in your pantry that collects dust? Well get ready to dust it off. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S02 E10 — South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S02 E09 — Hunting for Quail in Charleston Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S02 E08 — The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E09 — A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E02 — Guayabera World In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E04 — An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E09 — Yucatán's Most Unique Salts An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E10 — A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Fast Paced Roman Recipes Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.
